_comment: One entry per speaker, named as in the game export (dialogue_events.jsonl 'character'). folder = voice pack folder the plugin uses; prefix = key prefix of their lines (used when the export names no speaker); voices = reference clip per engine (relative to this folder, 10-25 s of clean speech); bible = voice and personality for the acting engines (normal lines); persona = one short sentence (intense lines); chatterbox_adjust = [exaggeration, cfg_weight] added to the emotion table (more extrovert = positive exaggeration).

CharacterA.bible: CharacterA, an adult woman; describe the voice (range, warmth, pace) and the personality here.
